about: An offer whose move would put a thing inside itself is greyed with the world's `inside_itself` (the spec's The runtime › The view), so `help`, which lists only what is not greyed, leaves out `take rowboat` aboard it, and `put pouch in crate` once the crate is in the pouch; typed, each is refused in those words.

expect.words: You can type: look, examine pouch, examine crate, inventory, wait, help, take pouch, take crate, close pouch, close crate, look in pouch, look in crate.
A rowboat cannot go inside itself.
You can type: look, examine pouch, examine crate, inventory, wait, help, take crate, drop pouch, close pouch, close crate, look in pouch, look in crate.
A pouch cannot go inside itself.
